before.title_es: Despensa de alimentos y Centro de Recursos
before.summary_es: Despensa de alimentos y centro de recursos que atiende a personas en crisis o en situación de pobreza en el suroeste del Condado de Williamson y el noroeste del Condado de Travis.
before.summary_en: Food pantry and resource center serving people in crisis or living in poverty in southwest Williamson County and northwest Travis County.
before.description_es: HCCM opera una despensa de alimentos con productos no perecederos y frescos, un ropero de ropa usada en buen estado, y ofrece asistencia financiera limitada para renta, servicios públicos y necesidades médicas o dentales, además de manejo de casos y referencias a otros recursos comunitarios. El servicio de alimentos está disponible en un área de 10 códigos postales; los solicitantes nuevos pueden llegar sin cita si residen en la zona elegible, mientras que los clientes recurrentes deben agendar cita.
before.description_en: HCCM operates a food pantry stocking nonperishable and fresh food, a clothes closet with gently used clothing, and provides limited financial assistance for rent, utilities, and medical/dental needs, along with case management and referrals to other community resources. Food assistance is available across a 10-ZIP-code service area; new clients may walk in if they live in the eligible area, while returning clients must schedule an appointment.
before.eligibility_es: Residentes de los códigos postales elegibles (78613, 78641, 78642, 78645, 78717, 78726, 78729, 78732, 78750, 78759) en el suroeste de Williamson y noroeste de Travis; se aplican límites de ingreso.
before.eligibility_en: Residents of eligible ZIP codes (78613, 78641, 78642, 78645, 78717, 78726, 78729, 78732, 78750, 78759) in southwest Williamson and northwest Travis counties; income guidelines apply.
before.required_documents_es: Formulario de solicitud de cliente (disponible en inglés, español y ucraniano); verificación de ingresos según el programa TEFAP.
before.required_documents_en: Client application form (available in English, Spanish, and Ukrainian); income verification per TEFAP program guidelines.
before.application_steps_es: Clientes nuevos en código postal elegible: visitar durante el horario de atención sin cita. Clientes recurrentes: llamar al 512-259-0360 ext. 201 para agendar cita.
before.application_steps_en: New clients in an eligible ZIP code: visit during open hours without an appointment. Returning clients: call 512-259-0360 ext. 201 to schedule an appointment.
before.hours_es: Lunes a viernes, 9:00 a.m.–12:00 p.m. y 1:00–3:00 p.m.; jueves con horario extendido hasta las 7:00 p.m.
before.hours_en: Monday–Friday, 9:00 a.m.–12:00 p.m. and 1:00–3:00 p.m.; extended hours Thursday until 7:00 p.m.
before.service_area_es: Condado de Travis, Condado de Williamson
before.verification_notes:
HCCM’s Food Pantry is located in Leander and serves eligible residents in Southwest Williamson County and Northwest Travis County, including specific ZIP codes in both counties. The pantry participates in the TEFAP program and provides food assistance at no cost to eligible households. Current pantry hours are Monday–Friday, 9:00 a.m.–12:00 p.m. and 1:00–3:00 p.m., with extended hours on Thursdays until 7:00 p.m. Applications are available in English and Spanish. Eligibility is based on TEFAP requirements and the household’s ZIP code.
Verificado directamente por Puente ATX

before.title_es: Servicios para Adultos Mayores
before.summary_es: Programa de seminarios bimensuales para adultos mayores en la Biblioteca Comunitaria de Lake Travis, en colaboración con la organización sin fines de lucro LT Senior Services.
before.summary_en: Bimonthly seminar program for older adults at the Lake Travis Community Library, run in partnership with the nonprofit LT Senior Services.
before.description_es: LT Senior Services se asocia con la Biblioteca Comunitaria de Lake Travis para ofrecer seminarios bimensuales dirigidos a adultos mayores sobre temas como opciones de vivienda para personas mayores, Medicare y atención médica. Las sesiones se ofrecen en formato híbrido, permitiendo asistir en persona o por Zoom.
before.description_en: LT Senior Services partners with the Lake Travis Community Library to offer bimonthly seminars for older adults on topics such as senior living options, Medicare, and healthcare. Sessions are offered in a hybrid format, allowing attendance in person or via Zoom.
before.eligibility_es: Adultos mayores y sus familias en el área de Lake Travis; abierto al público.
before.eligibility_en: Older adults and their families in the Lake Travis area; open to the public.
before.application_steps_es: Consultar el calendario de la biblioteca o de LT Senior Services para las próximas fechas; no se requiere inscripción previa para asistir.
before.application_steps_en: Check the library's or LT Senior Services' calendar for upcoming dates; no registration required to attend.
before.hours_es: Biblioteca (sede Lakeway): lunes a jueves 10 a.m.–7 p.m., viernes y sábado 10 a.m.–4 p.m.; los seminarios de adultos mayores son bimensuales, sin horario fijo semanal.
before.hours_en: Library (Lakeway branch): Monday–Thursday 10 a.m.–7 p.m., Friday–Saturday 10 a.m.–4 p.m.; senior seminars are bimonthly, with no fixed weekly schedule.
before.verification_notes: The Lake Travis Community Library continues to partner with Lake Travis Senior Services (LTSS) for an ongoing monthly educational seminar series focused on topics relevant to older adults and their families. Current library records confirm LTSS seminars were offered in 2026, including January, February, May, and June. Programs are primarily held at the Lakeway Library, with some activities offered through the library’s other locations. Library hours and locations were also verified through the library’s official website.

before.title_es: Despensa de Alimentos y Ayuda Financiera de Emergencia
before.summary_es: Organización voluntaria que ofrece despensa de alimentos y asistencia financiera de corto plazo (renta, servicios públicos, medicamentos y más) a residentes del área del distrito escolar Lake Travis ISD.
before.summary_en: All-volunteer organization providing a food pantry and short-term financial assistance (rent, utilities, medical costs, and more) to residents of the Lake Travis ISD area.
before.description_es: Lake Travis Crisis Ministries es una organización ecuménica y totalmente voluntaria que distribuye alimentos frescos y enlatados provenientes del Banco de Alimentos de Texas Central, y brinda ayuda financiera limitada y de corto plazo para renta, hipoteca, servicios públicos, gastos de auto, costos médicos y de prescripción, lentes, boletos de autobús de larga distancia y cuotas de examen GED. No cubre depósitos de renta o servicios públicos. Sirve a cualquier persona que viva o trabaje dentro del distrito Lake Travis ISD.
before.description_en: Lake Travis Crisis Ministries is an all-volunteer, ecumenical organization that distributes fresh and canned food from the Central Texas Food Bank and provides limited, short-term financial assistance for rent, mortgage, utilities, car expenses, medical and prescription costs, eyeglasses, long-distance bus tickets, and GED test fees. It does not cover rent or utility deposits. It serves anyone who lives or works within the Lake Travis ISD area.
before.eligibility_es: Personas que viven o trabajan dentro del distrito Lake Travis ISD (códigos postales 78732, 78734, 78738, 78669); abierto a todos sin importar fe, ingresos o circunstancias.
before.eligibility_en: People who live or work within the Lake Travis ISD area (ZIP codes 78732, 78734, 78738, 78669); open to everyone regardless of faith, income, or circumstances.
before.required_documents_es: Documento que compruebe residencia en la zona de servicio (factura de servicios, licencia de conducir, etc.); copias de facturas y comprobantes para asistencia financiera.
before.required_documents_en: Document proving residency in the service area (utility bill, driver's license, etc.); copies of bills and invoices for financial assistance requests.
before.application_steps_es: Presentarse sin cita durante el horario de atención para la evaluación inicial (miércoles 5–7 p.m. o jueves 10 a.m.–12 p.m.).
before.application_steps_en: Walk in during open hours for intake (Wednesday 5–7 p.m. or Thursday 10 a.m.–12 p.m.); no appointment needed.
before.hours_es: Miércoles, 5:00–7:00 p.m.; jueves, 10:00 a.m.–12:00 p.m.
before.hours_en: Wednesday, 5:00–7:00 p.m.; Thursday, 10:00 a.m.–12:00 p.m.
before.accessibility_notes_es: Se atiende sin cita previa durante el horario de servicio. No se requieren documentos para recibir asistencia alimentaria. Para la asistencia financiera, traiga facturas, recibos y documentos justificativos.
before.accessibility_notes_en: Walk-ins are welcome during service hours; no appointment is required. For food assistance, no documents are required. For financial assistance, bring bills, invoices, and supporting documents.
before.verification_notes:
Spanish availability not confirmed on the official website
Lake Travis Crisis Ministries is an all-volunteer organization serving individuals and families who live or work within the Lake Travis ISD area. Food pantry services are ongoing, while financial assistance is intended for short-term crisis situations and depends on available funds. No appointment is required.
Verificado directamente por Puente ATX

before.title_es: Biblioteca jurídica y ayuda para representarse sin abogado
before.summary_es: Biblioteca jurídica pública en Austin que ayuda a personas que se representan a sí mismas en las cortes civiles del Condado de Travis, sin costo.
before.summary_en: A public law library in Austin that helps people representing themselves in Travis County civil courts, at no cost.
before.description_es: El Travis County Law Library ha ayudado desde 1983 a residentes del condado a encontrar información legal. Su Self-Help Center ofrece orientación a personas que se representan a sí mismas en cortes civiles del Condado de Travis, incluyendo ayuda para investigar preguntas legales, formularios y referencias a sitios web y libros. Los bibliotecarios de derecho están disponibles en persona y también ofrecen servicios remotos.
before.description_en: The Travis County Law Library has helped county residents find legal information since 1983. Its Self-Help Center assists people representing themselves in Travis County civil courts, including help researching legal questions, providing forms, and pointing to websites and books. Law librarians are available in person and also offer remote services.
before.eligibility_es: Abierto al público, principalmente personas que se representan a sí mismas (sin abogado) en cortes civiles del Condado de Travis.
before.eligibility_en: Open to the public, primarily people representing themselves (without an attorney) in Travis County civil courts.
before.application_steps_es: Visite el Self-Help Center en 1700 Guadalupe St., 2.º piso, Austin, TX durante el horario de atención, llame al (512) 854-8677, o utilice los servicios remotos listados en el sitio web.
before.application_steps_en: Visit the Self-Help Center at 1700 Guadalupe St., 2nd Floor, Austin, TX during open hours, call (512) 854-8677, or use the remote services listed on the website.
before.hours_es: Lunes a viernes, 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. Cerrado sábados, domingos y días feriados oficiales.
before.hours_en: Monday–Friday, 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. Closed Saturdays, Sundays, and official holidays.
before.verification_notes: Address, phone, and hours confirmed via the library's own contact-us page. Cost (free public service) was not explicitly restated on the pages fetched today but is standard/well-established for Texas county law library self-help centers and was described this way in a Texas Law Help directory listing found in search results — flagged as reasonably but not 100% freshly confirmed. Note this office shares the same street address (1700 Guadalupe St.) as the County Clerk Civil Division (idx 91) and Recording Division sub-station (idx 88) — all are in the Civil and Family Courts Facility building, but are distinct organizations/services, not duplicates. Email not found/confirmed, left blank.

before.title_es: Impuestos sobre propiedades y servicios vehiculares
before.summary_es: Oficina que cobra los impuestos a la propiedad y procesa trámites de vehículos (registro y título) para residentes del Condado de Travis.
before.summary_en: The office that collects property taxes and processes vehicle transactions (registration and title) for Travis County residents.
before.description_es: Travis County Tax Office cobra los impuestos a la propiedad del condado y ofrece servicios de vehículos motorizados, incluyendo registro, título y trámites relacionados, en representación del Departamento de Vehículos Motorizados de Texas (TxDMV). Cuenta con varias sucursales en el condado, además de la oficina principal, y ofrece pago en línea, por correo y en persona.
before.description_en: The Travis County Tax Office collects county property taxes and provides motor vehicle services, including registration, title, and related transactions, on behalf of the Texas Department of Motor Vehicles (TxDMV). It operates several branch locations across the county in addition to the main office, and offers online, mail, and in-person payment options.
before.eligibility_es: Abierto a todos los propietarios de vehículos y contribuyentes de propiedad dentro del Condado de Travis.
before.eligibility_en: Open to all vehicle owners and property taxpayers within Travis County.
before.required_documents_es: Varía según el trámite (por ejemplo, identificación y comprobante de seguro para registro vehicular; información de la cuenta de la propiedad para pagos de impuestos).
before.required_documents_en: Varies by transaction (e.g., ID and proof of insurance for vehicle registration; property account information for tax payments).
before.application_steps_es: Realice el trámite en línea a través del portal del sitio web, por correo a la dirección postal correspondiente, o en persona en 2433 Ridgepoint Dr., Austin, TX u otras sucursales.
before.application_steps_en: Complete the transaction online through the website portal, by mail to the relevant P.O. box, or in person at 2433 Ridgepoint Dr., Austin, TX or other branch locations.
before.hours_es: Trámites de título y registro de vehículos: 8:00 a.m.–3:30 p.m., lunes a viernes. Trámites de impuestos a la propiedad: 7:30 a.m.–5:00 p.m., lunes a viernes.
before.hours_en: Vehicle title/registration walk-in: 8:00 a.m.–3:30 p.m., Monday–Friday. Property tax walk-in: 7:30 a.m.–5:00 p.m., Monday–Friday.
before.verification_notes: Main office address, phone, and walk-in hours confirmed via the office's own contact-us and visit-us pages. Note that this office has multiple branch locations across the county (search results referenced additional addresses such as 8656 W Hwy 71 and 4011 McKinney Falls Pkwy) — only the main/HQ location (2433 Ridgepoint Dr.) is included here; consider adding branches as separate records if Puente ATX wants full branch coverage. Email address required JavaScript/contact form and could not be extracted, so left blank. Lobby wait times and capacity limits mentioned as a caveat — hours are nominal open hours, not a guarantee of same-day service.

before.title_es: Actividades, ejercicio y comidas para adultos mayores
before.title_en: Activities, exercise, and meals for older adults
before.summary_es: Centro comunitario para adultos mayores en Bastrop que ofrece actividades sociales, clases de ejercicio y comidas comunitarias mediante una membresía anual de bajo costo.
before.summary_en: Community center for older adults in Bastrop offering social activities, exercise classes, and community meals through a low-cost annual membership.
before.description_es: El centro ofrece clases de acondicionamiento físico (incluyendo yoga y voleibol en silla), bingo, bridge, quilting, baile, y talleres educativos sobre diabetes, nutrición y tecnología básica. Se realiza un almuerzo comunitario los jueves y una cena comunitaria los martes seguida de baile con banda en vivo. La mayoría de los programas son de acceso libre (drop-in) con una donación de membresía sugerida de $25 al año; algunos programas pueden tener costos adicionales.
before.description_en: The center offers fitness classes (including chair yoga and chair volleyball), bingo, bridge, quilting, dancing, and educational workshops on diabetes, nutrition, and basic technology. A community potluck lunch is held Thursdays, and a potluck dinner is held Tuesdays followed by dancing with a live band. Most programs are drop-in with a suggested $25/year membership donation; some programs may have additional costs.
before.eligibility_es: Adultos mayores de la comunidad de Bastrop; se sugiere una donación de membresía de $25 al año.
before.eligibility_en: Older adults in the Bastrop community; a $25/year membership donation is suggested.
before.application_steps_es: Visitar el centro durante su horario de atención para inscribirse como miembro.
before.application_steps_en: Visit the center during operating hours to sign up for membership.
before.hours_es: Domingo 1:00–5:00 p.m.; lunes 9:00 a.m.–3:00 p.m.; martes y miércoles 9:00 a.m.–9:00 p.m.; jueves 9:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m.; viernes 9:00 a.m.–3:00 p.m.; sábado cerrado.
before.hours_en: Sunday 1:00–5:00 p.m.; Monday 9:00 a.m.–3:00 p.m.; Tuesday & Wednesday 9:00 a.m.–9:00 p.m.; Thursday 9:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m.; Friday 9:00 a.m.–3:00 p.m.; Saturday closed.
before.verification_notes: Could not directly fetch bastropcommunityseniorcenter.org (tool returned no usable content); hours, address, and membership fee were compiled from third-party listings (Bastrop Chamber of Commerce, SeniorCenters.com, findhelp.org) which may be stale — recommend confirming directly with the center (512-303-0072) before publishing. Note: phone number is identical in format style to Bastrop County Emergency Food Pantry's area but is a different number (512-303-0072 vs 512-303-0033) — visually similar, easy to transpose, double-check when entering data.

before.title_es: Actas vitales, escrituras y registros judiciales
before.title_en: Vital records, deeds, and court filings
before.summary_es: La Oficina del Secretario del Condado de Bastrop gestiona registros públicos como actas de nacimiento, matrimonio y defunción, escrituras de propiedad y documentos de tribunales de sucesiones y del condado.
before.summary_en: The Bastrop County Clerk's Office manages public records such as birth, marriage, and death certificates, property deeds, and probate/county court documents.
before.description_es: Esta oficina administra el registro de tierras, actas de nacimiento, matrimonio y defunción, presentaciones de negocios, marcas de ganado, gravámenes, y funciones administrativas de las cortes de sucesiones y del condado. Ofrece licencias de matrimonio y acceso a registros públicos, con algunos servicios disponibles a través de un portal de consulta en línea.
before.description_en: This office administers land recording, birth/marriage/death certificates, business filings, cattle brands, liens, and administrative functions for probate court and county court at law. It issues marriage licenses and provides access to public records, with some services available through an online lookup portal.
before.eligibility_es: Abierto al público general del Condado de Bastrop que necesite registrar o solicitar documentos públicos.
before.eligibility_en: Open to the general public in Bastrop County needing to record or request public documents.
before.required_documents_es: Varía según el trámite (por ejemplo, identificación con foto para licencias de matrimonio).
before.required_documents_en: Varies by transaction (e.g., photo ID for marriage licenses).
before.application_steps_es: Acudir en persona durante horario de oficina o usar el portal de registros en línea del condado, según el trámite.
before.application_steps_en: Visit in person during office hours or use the county's online records portal, depending on the transaction.
before.hours_es: Lunes a jueves 8:00 a.m. – 5:00 p.m.; viernes 8:00 a.m. – 4:00 p.m. Licencias de matrimonio: lunes a jueves 8:30 a.m. – 4:00 p.m.; viernes 8:30 a.m. – 3:00 p.m.
before.hours_en: Monday–Thursday 8:00 a.m. – 5:00 p.m.; Friday 8:00 a.m. – 4:00 p.m. Marriage licenses: Monday–Thursday 8:30 a.m. – 4:00 p.m.; Friday 8:30 a.m. – 3:00 p.m.
before.verification_notes: Confirmed today via the official bastropcounty.gov page (address 803 Pine Street, phone 512-332-7234). Note: some third-party directories (e.g., NETR Online) list a different address (804 Pecan Street) and phone (512-332-7236) — likely outdated or a related annex; the official .gov page was treated as authoritative. No email address was found on the official page. No fee schedule details were extracted (available as separate PDFs on the site) and no language-access information was found.

before.title_es: Asistencia alimentaria de emergencia
before.summary_es: Despensa de alimentos sin costo para residentes del Condado de Bastrop que enfrentan una necesidad alimentaria de emergencia, con servicios adicionales de apoyo hacia la autosuficiencia.
before.summary_en: A free food pantry for Bastrop County residents facing an emergency food need, with additional programs supporting self-sufficiency.
before.description_es: Bastrop County Emergency Food Pantry (BCEFP) ofrece asistencia alimentaria de emergencia, un programa de mochilas para niños (Nibbles Backpack), un mercado comunitario y talleres educativos para residentes del Condado de Bastrop. Los solicitantes deben ser mayores de 18 años, jefes de hogar y estar dentro del 185% del nivel federal de pobreza o enfrentar una situación de crisis. Se solicita identificación y comprobante de domicilio en cada visita. En 2026 la organización estrenó unas nuevas instalaciones en 1201 Pine Street.
before.description_en: Bastrop County Emergency Food Pantry (BCEFP) provides emergency food assistance, a children's backpack program (Nibbles Backpack), a community market, and educational workshops for Bastrop County residents. Applicants must be 18 or older, a head of household, and at or below 185% of the federal poverty level or facing a crisis situation. ID and proof of address are requested at each visit. In 2026 the organization opened a new facility at 1201 Pine Street.
before.eligibility_es: Residentes del Condado de Bastrop, mayores de 18 años, jefes de hogar, con ingresos hasta 185% del nivel federal de pobreza o en una situación de crisis alimentaria.
before.eligibility_en: Bastrop County residents, 18 or older, head of household, at or below 185% of the federal poverty level or facing a food crisis situation.
before.required_documents_es: Identificación con foto (licencia de conducir, identificación estatal, pasaporte, identificación consular o acta de nacimiento) y comprobante de domicilio del Condado de Bastrop (por ejemplo, una factura de servicios), solicitados en cada visita.
before.required_documents_en: Photo ID (driver's license, state ID, passport, foreign consulate ID, or birth certificate) and proof of Bastrop County residency (e.g., a utility bill), requested at each visit.
before.application_steps_es: Presentarse sin cita en 1201 Pine Street, Bastrop, TX en los horarios de atención, o llamar para programar cita en el programa Pantry Express; también se pueden agendar citas en línea.
before.application_steps_en: Walk in with no appointment needed at 1201 Pine Street, Bastrop, TX during service hours, or call to schedule an appointment for the Pantry Express program; appointments can also be booked online.
before.hours_es: Lunes, miércoles y viernes, 8:00–11:30 a.m. y 1:00–3:30 p.m. (cerrado de 12:00 a 1:00 p.m. para almuerzo). Pantry Express: primer jueves del mes, 4:00–7:00 p.m. (con cita); cuarto sábado del mes, 9:00 a.m.–12:00 p.m.
before.hours_en: Monday, Wednesday, Friday, 8:00–11:30 a.m. and 1:00–3:30 p.m. (closed 12:00–1:00 p.m. for lunch). Pantry Express: first Thursday of the month, 4:00–7:00 p.m. (by appointment); fourth Saturday of the month, 9:00 a.m.–12:00 p.m.
before.verification_notes: Confirmed current address (1201 Pine Street) and hours via the organization's own contact page and a January 2026 Community Impact news article about its new $7.5M facility opening. Older listings (ampleharvest.org, various directories, some search aggregations) still show the previous address (806 Fayette Street, Bastrop, TX), which appears to be superseded/outdated — flag for confirmation that 806 Fayette St. is fully retired (news coverage suggests Fayette St. may continue as an intake/warehouse site). Eligibility, required documents, Spanish availability, and free-of-charge status confirmed via aggregated search content attributed to the org's own program description. 'Emergency' in the name refers to short-term food-crisis assistance, not a 24/7 crisis hotline, so is_emergency is set to false per the stricter definition (shelters/crisis lines).

before.title_es: Vivienda pública y vales de Sección 8
before.summary_es: Administra vivienda pública y vales de Sección 8 para hogares de bajos ingresos, personas mayores y personas con discapacidad en la ciudad de Bastrop.
before.summary_en: Administers public housing and Section 8 Housing Choice Vouchers for low-income households, older adults, and people with disabilities in the city of Bastrop.
before.description_es: La Autoridad de Vivienda de Bastrop (BHA) administra tres programas: Sección 8 (vales de elección de vivienda), vivienda pública (50 unidades en 3 propiedades) y Piney Creek North (Sección 8 de nueva construcción basado en el proyecto). Ofrece unidades de 1, 2 y 3 recámaras. Los solicitantes deben tener 18 años o más (o ser menores emancipados), y al menos una persona del hogar debe ser ciudadano de EE. UU. o residente permanente legal.
before.description_en: The Bastrop Housing Authority (BHA) administers three programs: Section 8 (Housing Choice Vouchers), public housing (50 units across 3 properties), and Piney Creek North (project-based Section 8 new construction). It offers 1, 2, and 3 bedroom units. Applicants must be 18 or older (or an emancipated minor), and at least one household member must be a U.S. citizen or legal permanent resident.
before.eligibility_es: Hogares de bajos ingresos; personas mayores y con discapacidad tienen prioridad en ciertas unidades. Solicitante debe tener 18+ años (o ser menor emancipado); al menos un miembro del hogar debe ser ciudadano de EE. UU. o residente permanente legal. Estatus de listas de espera cambia con el tiempo.
before.eligibility_en: Low-income households; older adults and people with disabilities are prioritized for certain units. Applicant must be 18+ (or an emancipated minor); at least one household member must be a U.S. citizen or legal permanent resident. Waitlist status changes over time.
before.application_steps_es: Solicitar en línea a través del portal de solicitantes (pha-web.com) o en persona en la oficina durante horario de atención.
before.application_steps_en: Apply online through the applicant portal (pha-web.com) or in person at the office during business hours.
before.hours_es: Lunes a jueves: 9:00 a.m. - 5:00 p.m.
before.hours_en: Monday-Thursday: 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM
before.verification_notes: Address, phone, and hours confirmed directly on bastropha.org. Site displayed an old announcement stating 'All BHA Wait Lists will close Friday, February 24, 2023' (clearly stale), while a third-party directory (affordablehousingonline.com) says the public housing waitlist is currently open — these conflict and neither could be freshly confirmed, so waitlist status was left out of eligibility text. Recommend calling to confirm current waitlist status before publishing.

before.organization_name: U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) – VA Central Texas Healthcare System
before.title_es: VA Central Texas – Atención Médica para Veteranos
before.title_en: VA Central Texas – Veterans Health Care
before.summary_es: Sistema de atención médica y apoyo del VA que ofrece servicios de salud, salud mental, rehabilitación, medicamentos, equipo médico, atención para veteranos mayores, apoyo a cuidadores y otros servicios para veteranos elegibles y sus familias.
before.summary_en: VA health care and support system providing medical care, mental health services, rehabilitation, medications, medical equipment, geriatric care, caregiver support, and other services for eligible Veterans and their families.
before.description_es: Clínica ambulatoria para veteranos de Williamson County y áreas cercanas. Ofrece primary care, salud mental, laboratorio, salud de la mujer y otros servicios, coordinados a través de VA Central Texas.
before.description_en: Outpatient clinic for veterans in Williamson County and nearby areas. Offers primary care, mental health, lab services, women's health, and more, coordinated through VA Central Texas.
before.eligibility_es: Veteranos que cumplen con los requisitos de elegibilidad para recibir atención médica del VA. La elegibilidad generalmente depende del servicio militar y el tipo de baja, además de otros requisitos relacionados con el período y tipo de servicio. Los familiares y cuidadores pueden recibir ciertos servicios de apoyo, pero la atención médica del VA está principalmente destinada a veteranos elegibles.
before.eligibility_en: Veterans who meet VA health care eligibility requirements. Eligibility generally depends on military service and discharge status, with additional rules based on length and type of service and other circumstances. Family members and caregivers may receive certain support services, but VA health care itself is primarily for eligible Veterans.
before.hours_es: El horario varía según la ubicación y el servicio. Austin VA Clinic: lunes a viernes, 8:00 AM–4:30 PM; cerrado los fines de semana. Algunos servicios tienen horarios diferentes. También hay atención telefónica del VA.
before.hours_en: Hours vary by location and service. Austin VA Clinic: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–4:30 PM; closed weekends. Some services have different hours. VA telephone care is also available.
before.accessibility_notes_es: Los veteranos elegibles pueden solicitar atención médica del VA en línea, por teléfono, por correo o en persona. Una vez inscritos y registrados, pueden programar citas en línea o por teléfono. Algunos servicios también están disponibles mediante telehealth.
before.accessibility_notes_en: Eligible Veterans can apply for VA health care online, by phone, by mail, or in person. Once enrolled and registered, appointments can be scheduled online or by phone. Services may also be available through telehealth.
before.service_area_es: Centro de Texas – 39 condados. Cuenta con ubicaciones en Austin, Cedar Park, Temple, Waco, Brownwood, College Station, Copperas Cove y otras comunidades.
before.service_area_en: Central Texas – 39 counties. Locations include Austin, Cedar Park, Temple, Waco, Brownwood, College Station, Copperas Cove and other communities.
before.verification_notes:
Costs vary according to eligibility, priority group, income, disability status, and the specific service. Some Veterans receive care with no copay, while others may have copayments. Ask VA about individual eligibility and costs.
VA Central Texas is more than a medical provider—it is a major entry point for Veterans needing health care, benefits, social services, housing support, transportation, medical equipment, rehabilitation, and caregiver assistance. Veterans who are not yet enrolled can apply for VA health care. VA social workers can help Veterans, families, and caregivers identify and connect with community resources.
Verificado directamente por Puente ATX.

before.summary_es: Programa de asistencia benévola de la Iglesia Ascension en Bastrop que ayuda a residentes de Bastrop, Cedar Creek y Paige con el pago de servicios públicos.
before.summary_en: Benevolent assistance program of Ascension Catholic Church in Bastrop that helps residents of Bastrop, Cedar Creek, and Paige with utility bill payments.
before.description_es: A través de su Fondo Benevolente, la Iglesia Ascension en Bastrop ofrece ayuda para pagar servicios públicos (electricidad, agua y gas) a residentes de las ciudades de Bastrop, Cedar Creek o Paige, hasta $125 por solicitud, con un límite de una vez cada seis meses. Para solicitar, la persona debe presentarse en persona en la recepción de la oficina administrativa de la iglesia y completar el Formulario de Solicitud Benevolente.
before.description_en: Through its Benevolent Fund, Ascension Catholic Church in Bastrop offers help paying utility bills (electric, water, and gas) to residents of the cities of Bastrop, Cedar Creek, or Paige, up to $125 per request, limited to once every six months. To apply, a person must go in person to the front desk of the church's administrative office and complete a Benevolent Request Form.

before.eligibility_en: Residents of the cities of Bastrop, Cedar Creek, or Paige; benefit available once every 6 months, up to $125.

before.application_steps_en: Go in person to the front desk of the church administrative office during business hours and ask to complete the Benevolent Request Form.

before.title_es: Apoyo para niñas y niños víctimas de abuso
before.summary_es: Servicios coordinados y apoyo para reducir el trauma de niñas, niños y familias involucradas en investigaciones de abuso.
before.summary_en: Coordinated services and support that reduce trauma for children and families involved in abuse investigations.
before.description_es: WCCAC ofrece una respuesta coordinada y centrada en el niño ante casos de abuso infantil, incluyendo abuso sexual, trata infantil, abuso físico y negligencia, así como casos en los que un niño ha presenciado un crimen violento. Los servicios incluyen entrevistas forenses, exámenes médicos, apoyo de Family Advocacy y terapia enfocada en trauma. Los Family Advocates también ayudan a las familias a navegar el proceso de investigación y judicial y pueden conectarlas con recursos para alimentos, ropa, vivienda, asistencia legal, empleo y apoyo financiero.
before.description_en: WCCAC provides a coordinated, child-focused response to child abuse, including sexual abuse, child sex trafficking, physical abuse, neglect, and situations where a child has witnessed violent crime. Services include forensic interviews, medical examinations, Family Advocacy, and trauma-focused therapy. Family Advocates also help families navigate the investigation and legal process and connect them with resources for food, clothing, housing, legal assistance, employment, and financial support.
before.eligibility_es: Pueden ser elegibles los niños que han experimentado abuso o presenciado un crimen violento y sus familiares que no son ofensores. La elegibilidad para terapia se evalúa según las circunstancias y necesidades del niño.
before.eligibility_en: Children who have experienced abuse or witnessed violent crime and their non-offending family members may be eligible for services. Children typically receive a multidisciplinary response through law enforcement or DFPS. Therapy eligibility is assessed based on the child's circumstances and needs.
before.application_steps_es: Llama o visita el sitio web para confirmar disponibilidad y requisitos actuales.
before.application_steps_en: Call or visit the website to confirm current availability and requirements.
before.accessibility_notes_es: Comuníquese con WCCAC al 512-943-3701 o wccacinfo@wilcocactx.org. Los niños generalmente son referidos al Centro por las autoridades o Child Protective Services como parte de una respuesta coordinada.
before.accessibility_notes_en: Contact WCCAC at 512-943-3701 or wccacinfo@wilcocactx.org. Children are generally referred to the Center through law enforcement or Child Protective Services as part of a coordinated multidisciplinary response.
before.verification_notes:
Información revisada con la guía de Williamson County y la fuente oficial el 2026-08-07. Confirmar disponibilidad antes de publicar.

WCCAC is not a residential shelter and does not provide overnight lodging. When families need emergency housing, Family Advocates can help connect them with community partners. The Center also has a Crisis Closet providing emergency clothing and essential items.
Verificado directamente por Puente ATX.

before.hours_en:
Only during Cold Weather Shelter activations.
Cold Weather Shelter Hotline: 512-305-4233
Purpose: Check shelter activation status and access information.
Availability: 24/7 during cold-weather shelter operations.
before.verification_notes: Verificado directamente por Puente ATX.

before.title_es: Immigrant & Asylum Seeker Shelter & Support
before.title_en: Refugio y Apoyo para Inmigrantes y Solicitantes de Asilo
before.summary_es: Refugio y servicios de apoyo para inmigrantes y solicitantes de asilo, incluyendo vivienda temporal, alimentos, ropa, clases de inglés y acceso a recursos legales y médicos.
before.summary_en: Shelter and support services for immigrants and asylum seekers, including temporary housing, food, clothing, English classes, and access to legal and medical resources.
before.description_es: Casa Marianella ofrece refugio y apoyo integral para inmigrantes y solicitantes de asilo. Los servicios pueden incluir vivienda temporal, alimentos, ropa, clases de inglés y acceso a recursos médicos y legales. También ofrece programas especializados de vivienda para mujeres inmigrantes con hijos y familias que necesitan apoyo para establecerse y alcanzar la autosuficiencia.
before.description_en: Casa Marianella provides shelter and comprehensive support for immigrants and asylum seekers. Services may include temporary housing, food, clothing, English classes, and access to medical and legal resources. Specialized housing programs also support immigrant women with children and families as they work toward stability and self-sufficiency.
before.application_steps_es: Comunícate con la organización para confirmar disponibilidad, requisitos y cómo solicitar el servicio.
before.application_steps_en: Contact the organization to confirm availability, requirements, and how to request the service.
before.hours_es: Los programas de Casa Marianella funcionan según el tipo de servicio y no todos tienen el mismo horario ni acceso sin cita.
before.hours_en: By program and appointment. Contact Casa Marianella before visiting.
before.verification_notes:
Es principalmente un programa presencial y residencial. La admisión depende del programa y de las necesidades de la persona.
Casa Marianella actualmente cuenta con diferentes programas de vivienda, incluyendo: Refugio de Adultos,
Posada Esperanza — mujeres inmigrantes y sus hijos, Abri Lumière — familias inmigrantes
Verificado directamente por Puente ATX.

before.title_es: Tribunal Comunitario y Servicios para Personas sin Vivienda
before.summary_es: Servicios gratuitos de orientación, administración de casos y conexión con recursos para personas que enfrentan falta de vivienda y necesidades relacionadas con salud, vivienda, empleo y documentos.
before.summary_en: Free case management, resource navigation, and support services for people experiencing homelessness and needing help with housing, health, employment, documents, or court matters.
before.description_es: Ofrece administración de casos y orientación para personas que experimentan falta de vivienda, sin necesidad de cita para los servicios de atención sin cita. Puede ayudar a obtener identificaciones y documentos importantes, conectarse con servicios médicos, salud mental y tratamiento por uso de sustancias, buscar empleo, acceder a recursos de vivienda y otros servicios comunitarios. También ofrece apoyo para navegar casos, citas y requisitos de la corte.
before.description_en: Provides case management and resource navigation for people experiencing homelessness, with walk-in services available without an appointment. Assistance may include obtaining identification and vital documents, connecting to medical, mental health, and substance use services, accessing housing and employment resources, and navigating court cases and requirements.
before.application_steps_es: Comunícate con la organización para confirmar disponibilidad, requisitos y cómo solicitar el servicio.
before.application_steps_en: Contact the organization to confirm availability, requirements, and how to request the service.
before.hours_es:
Servicios para personas sin hogar (sin cita previa): No se requiere cita.
Servicios judiciales y de gestión de casos: El horario varía según el servicio. La Ciudad recomienda consultar el horario vigente antes de acudir.
before.hours_en:
Walk-in Homeless Services: No appointment required.
Court and case services: Hours vary depending on the service. The City recommends checking the current schedule before visiting.
before.verification_notes:
no marcaría Spanish como confirmado sin verificar directamente la disponibilidad de personal/intérprete.
Es particularmente útil porque funciona como una especie de “puerta de entrada” a múltiples recursos, en lugar de ser solamente una corte.
Verificado directamente por Puente ATX.

before.title_es: Apoyo Familiar y Violencia
before.summary_es: Servicios gratuitos y confidenciales para personas y familias afectadas por violencia doméstica, agresión sexual, abuso infantil y trata de personas.
before.summary_en: Free and confidential services for individuals and families affected by domestic violence, sexual assault, child abuse, and human trafficking.
before.description_es: The SAFE Alliance ofrece servicios gratuitos y confidenciales para sobrevivientes de violencia doméstica, agresión sexual, abuso infantil y trata de personas. Sus servicios incluyen apoyo en crisis, planificación de seguridad, refugio, consejería, asistencia legal, apoyo para vivienda y servicios para niños y familias.
before.description_en: The SAFE Alliance provides free and confidential services for survivors of domestic violence, sexual assault, child abuse, and human trafficking. Services include crisis support, safety planning, shelter, counseling, legal assistance, housing support, and services for children and families.
before.application_steps_es: Comunícate con la organización para confirmar disponibilidad, requisitos y cómo solicitar el servicio.
before.application_steps_en: Contact the organization to confirm availability, requirements, and how to request the service.
before.hours_es: Llamada: (512) 267-7233 (línea directa las 24 horas), Texto: (737) 888-7233
before.service_area_es: Condado de Travis & Centro de Texas
before.verification_notes:
Los servicios se ofrecen en diferentes ubicaciones y algunos requieren cita. Para encontrar el servicio adecuado, SAFEline (512-267-7233) es la mejor puerta de entrada.
Verificado directamente por Puente ATX.

before.title_es: Refugio de Emergencia para Mujeres y Niños
before.summary_es: Refugio de emergencia y servicios de apoyo para mujeres solas y mujeres con hijos que enfrentan falta de vivienda.
before.summary_en: Low-barrier emergency shelter and supportive services for single women and women with dependent children experiencing homelessness.
before.description_es: Refugio de emergencia de bajo nivel de barreras para mujeres solas y mujeres con hijos dependientes que enfrentan falta de vivienda. Ofrece alojamiento seguro, administración de casos, servicios de realojamiento, asistencia y capacitación laboral, cuidado infantil, terapia para niños y familias, capacitación en habilidades para la vida, apoyo educativo y referencias a recursos comunitarios.
before.description_en: Low-barrier emergency shelter for single women and women with dependent children experiencing homelessness. Services include safe shelter, case management, rapid rehousing, employment assistance and skills training, childcare, child and family therapy, life skills training, educational assistance, and referrals to community resources.
before.eligibility_es: Gratis: sujeto a requisitos de elegibilidad y disponibilidad.
before.eligibility_en: Free — eligibility and availability apply.
before.application_steps_es: Comunícate con la organización para confirmar disponibilidad, requisitos y cómo solicitar el servicio.
before.application_steps_en: Contact the organization to confirm availability, requirements, and how to request the service.
before.hours_es:
Refugio de emergencia: 24 horas al día, los 7 días de la semana (contacte al refugio para el ingreso y la disponibilidad).
Contacto/oficina del refugio: Lunes a viernes, de 9:00 a. m. a 5:00 p. m.
before.hours_en:
Emergency shelter: 24/7 (contact the shelter for intake and availability).
Shelter contact/office: Monday–Friday, 9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.
before.verification_notes:
Austin Shelter for Women & Children → mujeres solas o mujeres con hijos.
No encontré confirmación suficiente en la información oficial para marcarlo como un servicio formalmente bilingüe.
Verificado directamente por Puente ATX.

before.title_es: Free Community Meal
before.summary_es: Comida gratuita todos los jueves para cualquier persona que necesite alimentos. No se requiere registro ni cumplir requisitos.
before.summary_en: Free community meal every Thursday for anyone who is hungry. No registration or eligibility requirements.
before.description_es: University Baptist Church ofrece God’s Family Dinner, una comida gratuita para cualquier persona que tenga hambre. No hay requisitos ni restricciones para participar. El programa funciona aproximadamente 50 semanas al año y cierra únicamente durante las semanas de Thanksgiving y Christmas.
before.description_en: University Baptist Church offers God’s Family Dinner, a free meal for anyone who is hungry. There are no requirements or restrictions to participate. The program operates approximately 50 weeks a year and is closed only during Thanksgiving and Christmas weeks.
before.application_steps_es: Comunícate con la organización para confirmar disponibilidad, requisitos y cómo solicitar el servicio.
before.application_steps_en: Contact the organization to confirm availability, requirements, and how to request the service.
before.hours_es:
God’s Family Dinner: Jueves por la tarde/noche — consulta el sitio web para conocer el horario actual de servicio.
Horario de oficina: de lunes a jueves, de 10:00 a. m. a 3:00 p. m.
before.hours_en:
God's Family Dinner: Thursday evening — check website for current serving time.
Office hours: Monday–Thursday, 10:00 a.m.–3:00 p.m.
before.verification_notes:
La información oficial está principalmente en inglés. No encontré confirmación suficiente para indicar que el servicio de comida se ofrece formalmente en español, así que no lo marcaría como bilingual en PuenteATX.
Verificado directamente por Puente ATX.

before.title_es: Lone Star Circle of Care en Bastrop
before.title_en: Lone Star Circle of Care at Bastrop
before.summary_es: Centro de salud comunitario de Lone Star Circle of Care en Bastrop que ofrece medicina familiar, pediatría y salud conductual, con tarifas ajustadas según ingresos para pacientes sin seguro.
before.summary_en: A Lone Star Circle of Care community health center in Bastrop offering family medicine, pediatrics, and behavioral health, with income-based sliding fees for uninsured patients.
before.description_es: Lone Star Circle of Care en Bastrop es un centro de salud calificado a nivel federal (FQHC) que ofrece medicina familiar, pediatría, salud conductual (psicoterapia y psiquiatría) y consultas virtuales. Antes de la primera cita, un asesor del programa realiza una evaluación de ingresos para determinar la elegibilidad para la escala móvil de tarifas; ningún paciente es rechazado por no poder pagar. El centro también coordina 'Family Connects Texas', un programa gratuito de visitas domiciliarias de enfermería para familias con recién nacidos en el condado de Bastrop.
before.description_en: Lone Star Circle of Care at Bastrop is a federally qualified health center (FQHC) offering family medicine, pediatrics, behavioral health (psychotherapy and psychiatry), and virtual visits. Before the first appointment, a program adviser conducts an income screening to determine eligibility for the sliding fee scale; no patient is turned away for inability to pay. The center also coordinates 'Family Connects Texas,' a free in-home nurse visit program for families with newborns in Bastrop County.
before.eligibility_es: Abierto al público en general, incluyendo pacientes sin seguro médico; la elegibilidad para la escala móvil se determina mediante evaluación de ingresos. El programa Family Connects es para familias con un recién nacido que residen en el condado de Bastrop.
before.eligibility_en: Open to the general public, including uninsured patients; eligibility for the sliding fee scale is determined through an income screening. The Family Connects program is for families with a newborn residing in Bastrop County.
before.application_steps_es: Programe una cita en línea a través de Athena (para proveedores seleccionados) o llame al número gratuito 1-877-800-5722.
before.application_steps_en: Schedule an appointment online through Athena (for select providers) or call the toll-free number 1-877-800-5722.
before.hours_es: Lunes a viernes, 8:00 a.m. a 5:00 p.m.
before.hours_en: Monday–Friday, 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.
before.verification_notes: Confirmado hoy en la página oficial lonestarcares.org. La política de escala móvil se confirmó mediante la página general de elegibilidad y pago de LSCC (fuente secundaria del mismo dominio).

before.title_es: Administración del Seguro Social – Oficina de Austin
before.title_en: Social Security Administration (SSA) – Austin Field Office
before.summary_es: Agencia federal que administra beneficios de jubilación, discapacidad, Seguro Social para sobrevivientes, SSI y Medicare, además de servicios relacionados con las tarjetas y números de Seguro Social.
before.summary_en: Federal agency that administers Social Security retirement, disability, survivor, SSI, and Medicare-related programs, as well as Social Security number and card services.
before.description_es: La Administración del Seguro Social (SSA) es una agencia federal que administra programas de beneficios para jubilación, discapacidad, sobrevivientes y Seguridad de Ingreso Suplementario (SSI). También ofrece servicios relacionados con tarjetas y números de Seguro Social, Medicare, comprobantes de beneficios, estado de solicitudes, cambios de información y apelaciones. Muchas gestiones pueden realizarse en línea a través de una cuenta my Social Security. Cuando se requiere atención presencial, la SSA recomienda hacer una cita antes de acudir a una oficina.
before.description_en: The Social Security Administration (SSA) is a federal agency that administers retirement, disability, survivor, and Supplemental Security Income (SSI) benefits. It also provides services related to Social Security cards and numbers, Medicare, benefit verification, application status, information updates, and appeals. Many services can be completed online through a my Social Security account. When in-person assistance is needed, SSA recommends making an appointment before visiting a local office.
keywords_es: estado de cuenta del Seguro Social
before.eligibility_es: Ciudadanos estadounidenses y personas no ciudadanas que cumplan con los requisitos del servicio específico de Seguro Social, SSI, Medicare o servicios relacionados con la tarjeta. Los requisitos varían según el programa y las circunstancias de cada persona.
before.eligibility_en: U.S. citizens and eligible noncitizens who meet the requirements for the specific Social Security, SSI, Medicare, or card-related service. Eligibility varies by program and individual circumstances.
before.application_steps_es: Contacte a la oficina o consulte su sitio web para confirmar requisitos y proceso.
before.application_steps_en: Contact the office or check its website to confirm requirements and process.
before.hours_es: Lunes–viernes, 9:00 AM–4:00 PM. Cerrado fines de semana y días festivos federales. Se recomienda hacer una cita y muchos servicios presenciales requieren cita.
before.hours_en: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–4:00 PM. Closed weekends and federal holidays. Appointments are recommended/required for many in-person services.
before.accessibility_notes_es: En línea a través de SSA.gov y my Social Security, por teléfono, por correo o en persona cuando sea necesario. Se recomienda hacer una cita antes de visitar la oficina. Muchos trámites pueden completarse en línea sin acudir personalmente.
before.accessibility_notes_en: Online through SSA.gov and my Social Security, by phone, by mail, or in person at a local field office when needed. Make an appointment before visiting. Many services can be completed online without visiting an office.
before.service_area_es: El área de servicio incluye partes de los condados de Bastrop, Hays, Travis y Williamson.
before.service_area_en: Austin Field Office service area includes parts of Bastrop, Hays, Travis, and Williamson Counties.
before.verification_notes:
Costo: Social Security services and benefit applications are generally free. Some replacement documents or related services may have specific rules or fees; verify with SSA before applying.

Important: Do not list this as a general walk-in resource. SSA recommends making an appointment before visiting. Many services can be completed online. Use the official SSA Office Locator with the family's ZIP code because SSA has more than one Austin field office and the appropriate office can depend on the person's address. The national phone line offers Spanish assistance by pressing 7.
Verificado directamente por Puente ATX.

before.title_es: Manos de Cristo – Salud Dental, Necesidades Básicas y Educación
before.title_en: Manos de Cristo – Dental Care, Basic Needs & Education
before.summary_es: Organización sin fines de lucro que ofrece servicios dentales de bajo costo y apoyo con necesidades básicas y educación para personas y familias de bajos ingresos en Central Texas.
before.summary_en: Nonprofit organization providing affordable dental care, basic-needs assistance, and adult education for low-income individuals and families in Central Texas.
before.description_es: Manos de Cristo ayuda a personas y familias de bajos ingresos mediante tres áreas principales: atención dental accesible, necesidades básicas y educación. Su Centro Dental ofrece servicios de emergencia, preventivos y restaurativos a personas sin seguro dental o que no califican para determinados programas de asistencia. La organización también ofrece una despensa de alimentos y un armario de ropa, además de clases de educación para adultos, incluyendo ESL, computación básica y ciudadanía.
before.description_en: Manos de Cristo supports low-income individuals and families through three primary areas: affordable dental care, basic needs, and education. Its Dental Center provides emergency, preventive, and restorative services for people without dental insurance or who do not qualify for certain assistance programs. The organization also operates a food pantry and clothing closet and offers adult education, including ESL, basic computer skills, and citizenship classes.
before.eligibility_es: Personas y familias de bajos ingresos. Los requisitos varían según el programa. Los servicios dentales están dirigidos principalmente a personas sin seguro dental que cumplen con los requisitos de ingresos.
before.eligibility_en: Low-income individuals and families. Eligibility varies by program. Dental services are primarily for people without dental insurance who meet the program's income requirements.
before.hours_es: Los horarios varían según el programa. La despensa de alimentos ha operado de lunes a viernes, de 8:00 AM a 11:00 AM. Se recomienda confirmar el horario y los requisitos antes de acudir.
before.hours_en: Hours vary by program. The food pantry has operated Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–11:00 AM. Confirm current hours and requirements before visiting.
before.accessibility_notes_es: Comuníquese con Manos de Cristo o visite su ubicación para conocer los requisitos y disponibilidad del servicio específico. Los servicios dentales requieren evaluación y elegibilidad; los programas de necesidades básicas y educación pueden tener requisitos diferentes.
before.accessibility_notes_en: Contact Manos de Cristo or visit the organization to learn about eligibility and availability for the specific service. Dental services require eligibility screening; basic-needs and education programs may have different requirements.
before.service_area_es: Austin y Central Texas; principalmente Travis County.
before.service_area_en: Austin and Central Texas; primarily Travis County.
before.verification_notes:
Cost: Varies by service. Dental care is offered at reduced/affordable rates rather than being universally free. Food, clothing, and some educational/community programs may be free, subject to eligibility and availability.
Es importante verificar los horarios, requisitos e inventario antes de referir a una familia, ya que los servicios y disponibilidad pueden cambiar. Manos de Cristo tiene una larga trayectoria atendiendo a personas de bajos ingresos en Central Texas.
Verificado directamente por Puente ATX.

before.title_es: Orientación y reclamos de beneficios para veteranos
before.title_en: Veterans benefits counseling and claims assistance
before.summary_es: Oficina del Condado de Bastrop que orienta a veteranos y familiares elegibles para solicitar beneficios federales, estatales y locales, incluyendo discapacidad, pensiones, educación y beneficios funerarios.
before.summary_en: A Bastrop County office that counsels veterans and eligible family members on applying for federal, state, and local benefits, including disability, pensions, education, and burial benefits.
before.description_es: La Oficina de Servicios para Veteranos del Condado de Bastrop ayuda con reclamos de discapacidad de VA, pensiones, beneficios de educación, préstamos hipotecarios, beneficios funerarios y programas de cuidador. Además de la oficina principal en Bastrop, atiende con cita en un anexo en Elgin (jueves) y en el Ayuntamiento de Smithville (miércoles).
before.description_en: The Bastrop County Veterans Service Office helps with VA disability claims, pensions, education benefits, home loans, burial benefits, and caregiver programs. In addition to the main Bastrop office, it holds appointment-only hours at an Elgin annex (Thursdays) and Smithville City Hall (Wednesdays).
before.eligibility_es: Veteranos y familiares elegibles del Condado de Bastrop.
before.eligibility_en: Veterans and eligible family members of Bastrop County.
before.application_steps_es: Llamar al (512) 581-4006 o enviar correo a veterans.service@co.bastrop.tx.us para programar una cita.
before.application_steps_en: Call (512) 581-4006 or email veterans.service@co.bastrop.tx.us to schedule an appointment.
before.hours_es:
Oficina principal (Bastrop): lunes a jueves, 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m., con cita. 
Anexo de Elgin: jueves, 1:30–3:00 p.m. 
Ayuntamiento de Smithville: miércoles, 1:30–3:00 p.m.
before.hours_en:
Main office (Bastrop): Monday–Thursday, 8:00 am–5:00 pm, by appointment. 
Elgin annex: Thursdays, 1:30–3:00 pm. 
Smithville City Hall: Wednesdays, 1:30–3:00 pm.
before.verification_notes:
Confirmed today via the official bastropcounty.gov page. LIKELY CROSS-BATCH DUPLICATE: this record (idx 126, 'Bastrop County Veterans Service Office') may be the same office as a 'Bastrop County Government — Oficina de Servicios para Veteranos' record described elsewhere in this larger project (a different batch). Recommend the admin compare organization name, phone (512) 581-4006, and address (104 Loop 150, Bastrop, TX 78602) across batches before publishing both.
Verificado directamente por Puente ATX

before.title_es: Conexión con Servicios de Salud y Apoyo Comunitario
before.summary_es: Organización de impacto colectivo que conecta a residentes del Condado de Bastrop con navegación de servicios de salud y sociales, transporte a citas médicas y ayuda para inscribirse en beneficios.
before.summary_en: Collective-impact nonprofit that connects Bastrop County residents to health and social service navigation, transportation to medical appointments, and help enrolling in benefits.
before.description_es: Bastrop County Cares funciona como organización 'backbone' que une a socios públicos, privados y confesionales del Condado de Bastrop. Ofrece CARE Rides (transporte a citas médicas para personas mayores elegibles y mujeres embarazadas), trabajadores de salud comunitarios que ayudan a navegar servicios de salud y sociales, apoyo de doulas, e inscripción gratuita en beneficios (SNAP, TANF, Medicaid, CHIP, WIC) en alianza con Foundation Communities el tercer miércoles de cada mes. También ofrece talleres educativos y actividades comunitarias.
before.description_en: Bastrop County Cares acts as a 'backbone' organization uniting public, private, and faith-based partners across Bastrop County. It offers CARE Rides (transportation to medical appointments for eligible seniors and expecting mothers), community health workers who help residents navigate health and social services, doula support, and free benefits enrollment help (SNAP, TANF, Medicaid, CHIP, WIC) in partnership with Foundation Communities on the third Wednesday of each month. It also runs educational workshops and community activities.
before.eligibility_es: Residentes del Condado de Bastrop; CARE Rides es para personas mayores elegibles y mujeres embarazadas; otros programas pueden tener requisitos propios.
before.eligibility_en: Bastrop County residents; CARE Rides is for eligible seniors and expecting mothers; other programs may have their own requirements.
before.application_steps_es: Llamar al 512-409-3116 para navegación de servicios o CARE Rides, o consultar el sitio web para programas específicos como la inscripción de beneficios (tercer miércoles del mes).
before.application_steps_en: Call 512-409-3116 for service navigation or CARE Rides, or check the website for specific programs like benefits enrollment (third Wednesday of the month).
before.hours_es: Línea de llamadas L–V 9am–4pm
before.hours_en: Call line Mon–Fri (9 am–4 pm)
before.verification_notes:
Verified directly by Puente ATX: Bastrop County Cares is a separate organization from the Bastrop County Emergency Food Pantry (bastropfoodpantry.org); they are different nonprofits and should not be treated as duplicates. The organization’s official website lists its office at 806 Water St., Bastrop, TX 78602. However, this is an administrative office and should not be assumed to be a walk-in location for all services, which may be provided through community health workers, partner organizations, and off-site events. The website provides Spanish-language content through an “Español” option, but live Spanish-language phone navigation was not independently confirmed.
Verificado directamente por Puente ATX.

before.organization_name: Creedmoor Elementary – Feeding Futures School Pantry
before.title_es: Despensa Móvil de Creedmoor Elementary
before.summary_es: Despensa móvil de alimentos operada por el Banco de Alimentos de Texas Central en Creedmoor Elementary, parte del programa escolar Feeding Futures de Del Valle ISD.
before.summary_en: Mobile food pantry operated by the Central Texas Food Bank at Creedmoor Elementary, part of Del Valle ISD's Feeding Futures school pantry program.
before.description_es: Como parte del programa Feeding Futures, el Banco de Alimentos de Texas Central y Del Valle ISD operan una despensa móvil en Creedmoor Elementary que distribuye alimentos básicos, frutas, verduras, proteínas y lácteos a estudiantes y sus familias, además de apoyo complementario como educación nutricional y ayuda con beneficios. Fue la primera despensa escolar de este tipo en Central Texas, lanzada en enero de 2024.
before.description_en: As part of the Feeding Futures program, the Central Texas Food Bank and Del Valle ISD operate a mobile pantry at Creedmoor Elementary distributing shelf-stable staples, fresh produce, protein, and dairy to students and their families, along with wraparound support such as nutrition education and benefits assistance. It was the first school-based pantry of its kind in Central Texas, launched in January 2024.
keywords_es: Banco de Alimentos de Texas Central
before.eligibility_es: Estudiantes de Creedmoor Elementary (Del Valle ISD) y sus familias; distribución dirigida a la comunidad escolar.
before.eligibility_en: Creedmoor Elementary (Del Valle ISD) students and their families; distribution aimed at the school community.
before.application_steps_es: Acudir el día de distribución programado; no se requiere inscripción previa.
before.application_steps_en: Attend on the scheduled distribution day; no prior registration required.
before.hours_es: Tercer martes del mes, aproximadamente 8:30 a.m. (verificar calendario vigente)
before.hours_en: 3rd Tuesday of the month, approximately 8:30 a.m. (confirm current schedule)

before.title_es: Biblioteca, Programas y Recursos Gratuitos para la Comunidad
before.title_en: Free Library Programs and Community Resources
before.summary_es: Biblioteca comunitaria que ofrece acceso a libros y recursos digitales, computadoras, Wi-Fi, impresión y programas educativos y familiares. Muchos de sus programas son gratuitos y abiertos al público.
before.summary_en: Community library offering books and digital resources, computers, Wi-Fi, printing, and educational and family programs. Many programs are free and open to the public.
before.description_es: Ofrece acceso a una colección de libros y recursos digitales, computadoras, Wi-Fi, impresión, copias, actividades para niños y familias, programas educativos, clubes de lectura y otros eventos comunitarios. También cuenta con recursos digitales como libros electrónicos, audiolibros, revistas, películas y herramientas de aprendizaje.
before.description_en: Provides access to books and digital resources, computers, Wi-Fi, printing, copies, children's and family activities, educational programs, book clubs, and community events. Digital resources include eBooks, audiobooks, magazines, films, and learning tools.
before.eligibility_es: Los programas generalmente son gratuitos y abiertos a todas las personas. Los beneficios de la membresía dependen del lugar donde viva. Las personas que viven en el distrito o pertenecen a Eanes ISD pueden obtener una membresía familiar gratuita.
before.eligibility_en: Library programs are generally free and open to everyone. Library membership benefits depend on where you live. Residents of the Westbank Library District or Eanes ISD qualify for a free Family Membership. Other Texas residents may have other membership options.
before.hours_es: Lunes a jueves, 10:00 a.m.–7:00 p.m.; viernes a domingo, 10:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.
before.hours_en: Monday–Thursday, 10:00 a.m.–7:00 p.m.; Friday–Sunday, 10:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.
before.accessibility_notes_es: Puede visitar la biblioteca, llamar al 512-327-3045 o utilizar los recursos en línea. Los programas generalmente son gratuitos y abiertos al público; no se requiere tarjeta de biblioteca, salvo que el programa indique lo contrario.
before.accessibility_notes_en: Visit the library, call 512-327-3045, or use its online resources. Programs are generally free and open to the public; a library card is not required unless specified.
before.service_area_es: Condado de Travis: principalmente en el área de Westlake/Eanes.
before.verification_notes:
Servicio: Visit the library, call 512-327-3045, or use its online resources. Programs are generally free and open to the public; a library card is not required unless specified.

Westbank Libraries is a separate library district and is not part of Austin Public Library. People outside the district can still participate in many free public programs, but borrowing and digital access depend on membership eligibility.

before.title_es: Clases de Español para la Comunidad
before.summary_es: Clases de español ofrecidas a través del Lakeway Activity Center para personas interesadas en aprender o mejorar sus conocimientos del idioma.
before.summary_en: Spanish classes offered through the Lakeway Activity Center for community members who want to learn or improve their Spanish skills.
before.description_es: Oportunidad educativa para aprender o mejorar el español mediante clases ofrecidas por el Lakeway Activity Center. Las clases y sus requisitos pueden variar según la sesión. Se recomienda consultar el catálogo actual para confirmar disponibilidad, horario y requisitos de inscripción.
before.description_en: Educational opportunity to learn or improve Spanish through classes offered by the Lakeway Activity Center. Class availability and requirements may vary by session. Check the current activity guide for the latest schedule and registration information.
before.eligibility_es: Miembros de la comunidad que cumplen los requisitos para la clase específica. La elegibilidad puede variar según el curso.
before.eligibility_en: Community members who meet the requirements for the specific class. Eligibility may vary by course.
before.hours_es: Varía según la clase y la sesión; consulte la guía de actividades vigente para conocer las fechas y los horarios.
before.hours_en: Varies by class and session; check the current activity guide for dates and times.
before.accessibility_notes_es: Clases presenciales; se requiere inscripción a través del Lakeway Activity Center.
before.accessibility_notes_en: In-person classes; registration is required through the Lakeway Activity Center.
before.verification_notes:
Free – for the specific Spanish class identified as free. Other classes at the Activity Center may have fees.
The Lakeway Activity Center offers a Spanish class listed as free.
